final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode sinks IREF (10 uA), long L for high ro
Mref  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=8 m=8
* tail current source 10 uA
Mtail tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=8 m=8
* NMOS input pair (vinp -> x side = non-inverting)
M1    n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=30 L=3
M2    x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=30 L=3
* PMOS mirror load: unit device W=16 L=3 (5 uA each)
M3    n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=16 L=3
M4    x     n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=16 L=3
* second stage: PMOS CS driver = 6x unit (30 uA, matched density -> x = n1)
M6    vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W=16 L=3 m=6
M7    vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=8 m=24
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz    x     nz    8k
Cc    nz    vout  3.3p
.ends
